items.title: Kering stock falls 3.22 percent as Gucci recovery slows
items.summary: Kering shares closed at EUR 210.30 on Oct 2, down 3.22% and 40.6% below the 52-week high, after a cautious pre-close call; H1 2026 net income fell 60% to EUR 189 million with Gucci comparable revenue down 5%. Citi cut its target to EUR 243 (Hold); Q3 sales are due Oct 22.

items.title: Il CEO di Kering ribadisce: nessuna intenzione di spostare la produzione fuori dall'Italia
items.summary: At the opening of Kering's 2026-27 excellence academy in Milan, CEO Luca de Meo said there is "no intention of transferring production outside Italy," noting 85% of output stays Italian and framing the two China-made Gucci sneaker lines as a technical exception, not a strategic shift.

items.title: Gucci printemps-ete 2027: Demna transforme la boutique en theatre de la mode
items.summary: French-language review praising Demna's SS27 'Store Show' for its cast of unapologetic female characters (Anok Yai, Elsa Hosk, Rosie Huntington-Whiteley among them) and its shift toward theatrical, excess-embracing silhouettes, calling it a strategically relevant read on contemporary luxury.

items.title: HSBC reduit son objectif sur Gucci mais conseille toujours d'acheter
items.summary: HSBC trimmed its Kering target from EUR 305 to EUR 300 after management flagged slower new-product cadence than Q2, softer store traffic (partly offset by better conversion) and unfavorable comps; the bank kept a Buy rating, backing the 'quality, creativity, price discipline' repositioning under Demna.

items.title: Gucci S/S 2027 Milan - forum thread, page 2
items.summary: Long-running fashion-community thread dissecting the SS27 'Store Show' menswear and womenswear separately; posters disco54 and HazJW called the womenswear 'abysmal' and said 'the bar was on the floor,' while FashionPower compared menswear to 'Polo Ralph Lauren x Celine by Rider,' reflecting a split verdict between the two lines.

items.title: Forum members review the 'vulgar' Gucci Spring 2027 collection from Demna
items.summary: PurseForum members reacted sharply negatively to the SS27 show, with user Thefrenchy calling it 'a tragedy... haven't seen a collection so vulgar in a while' and RobAllen4599 predicting 'this will be his final season'; a handful of other posters pushed back, but the thread's dominant word was 'vulgar.'

items.title: Demna's Gucci is selling a dream
items.summary: Critic review praising the SS27 show's 'warmth and wit' and 'tender irony,' arguing Demna's multiple-stereotype casting (the rebellious aristocrat, the snob, the eccentric) is a sophisticated reading of what Gucci means to different people, defending the show's overt commerciality as historically consistent with couture's purpose to sell.

items.source: incoder.tw Observer Report (fashion-criticism newsletter, EU show subject)
items.title: "This will be his final season": Demna reads Gucci as belonging, the forum reads only vulgar
items.summary: Independent critic/newsletter piece aggregating social and forum reaction to the SS27 Milan show, framing the gap between Demna's stated intent (Gucci as a sense of 'belonging') and community reception, where the repeated descriptor among fans was simply 'vulgar.'
